units.source_text: 大学预科一年所修的课程有修身、国语、汉文、华语、英语、历史、佛典、逻辑、数学、体操等十个课目。

en.t: In the first year of the university preparatory course, the subjects we studied included ethics, Japanese, classical Chinese, Chinese, English, history, Buddhist scriptures, logic, mathematics, and gymnastics, ten subjects in all.

units.source_text: 逻辑课从开始就使我感到苦恼。

en.t: From the very beginning, logic class caused me distress.

units.source_text: 有一天，上完这节课，午休时我带着两三个问题，

en.t: One day, after that class was over, I took two or three questions with me during the lunch break,

units.source_text: 试图求教于一个我所期待的同学。

en.t: and tried to ask a classmate on whom I had placed my hopes for help.
